description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions for managing prplMesh components, including starting, stopping, and signaling processes, log rotation, and configuration parameter management.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a termination signal to a specified prplMesh process.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process specified by its program name.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process gracefully, with a fallback to kill after a timeout.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Performs log rotation for prplMesh logs in /tmp/beerocks/logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage help for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from ODL configuration files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in ODL configuration files.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the prplmesh platform database is available.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts human-readable certification modes to numeric values.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes for prplMesh.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts prplMesh processes based on current configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling command-line arguments and orchestrating start/stop/restart.
